target_customer: Consumers shopping for a specific product who want it today from nearby independent and chain stores, plus local retailers who list inventory
problem: Shoppers cannot easily see which nearby store has a product in stock, so they default to online retailers and wait for shipping.
business_model: Local inventory search with same-day delivery, likely a retailer fee or delivery margin (not stated in sources)
product_category: Local commerce search and same-day delivery

founders.name: Ian McHenry
prior_employers: Oliver Wyman (consultant on airline dynamic pricing)
founders.background_notes: Source is the YC company page. The company's site is instock.org. Santa Cruz Works interview says the company started in Santa Cruz.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed to aggregate store inventory feeds or scrape listings and run same-day delivery logistics, both standard but operationally heavy for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Inventory data came from third parties and delivery used commodity couriers, so a larger player could replicate the experience.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found describing what incumbents did to In Stock specifically.

market_need_then: The founder says the idea came from a last minute gift search that ended at a Santa Cruz store (local news piece found in search). Pandemic era 2020 pushed demand for local pickup and delivery, but no hard demand figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Company site is instock.org; no source on how the domain was obtained.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a generic phrase shared with a robotics company named Instock and a Chrome extension called In Stock; no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: YC lists In Stock as inactive but no shutdown notice, post-mortem or press about the cause was found, so the cause is not public. The idea sat in a space with strong incumbents in search and same-day delivery, and a solo founder with a team of two, so the likely pressures were distribution and unit economics, but no source states this. Failure factor is recorded as other because the cause is unknown.
notes: Website field is empty in the directory; instock.org appears in press. The website fetch was not possible since no URL was listed. The $125,000 figure rests on a single job-listing aggregator and is probably the standard YC deal but no source says so. No cause of inactivity found.
